security.deleteAccountSub: Delete your account and personal details
security.deleteAccountBody:
This permanently deactivates your account and removes your personal details (name, email, phone, photo and addresses).

• Your order and transaction records are kept for legal and accounting purposes
• You will be signed out on all devices
• This cannot be undone
• Complete or cancel any active orders first
security.deleteConfirmBody: To finish deleting your account, type the email address on your account below. This permanently removes your account and cannot be undone.
